login.title: Use WhatsApp on your PC
login.step2: On Android tap Menu ⋮, on iPhone tap Settings.
login.step3: Tap Linked devices, then Link a device.
login.step4: Point your phone at this screen to scan the code.
login.phoneIntro: Enter the phone number of your WhatsApp account, with the country code.
login.codeIntro: On your phone, open Linked devices, tap Link a device, then Link with phone number instead, and enter:
login.privacy: WinWhatsApp links to your phone the way WhatsApp Web does. Your messages are kept on this PC only.
login.privacy@unix: WinWhatsApp links to your phone the way WhatsApp Web does. Your messages are kept on this computer only.
login.wholeNumber: Enter the whole number, starting with the country code.
media.sendAsFilesTooltip: Send them in their original quality, as files
